points.description: States missing detail about the vinegar, such as its type or brand, its acidity (concentration), or the volume used in each container. Equivalent wording earns the mark.
States missing detail about the samples or containers, such as the size, shape or surface area of each sample, or the size and material of the container. Equivalent wording earns the mark.

States missing detail about the conditions, such as the temperature of the room or storage, how the samples were rinsed and dried, or the precision of the balance used to measure mass. Equivalent wording and any other reasonable missing condition earn the mark.

rubric.notes: Award one mark for each of three different pieces of missing information that would allow the experiment to be repeated, drawn from the categories above or any equivalent valid detail. Vague statements such as "more details" earn no mark. Two details from the same category earn only one mark.
